card.name: Agbekor
card.tagline: Ewe and Fon war dance once known as Atamga ('great oath')
card.profile: Agbekor is a music-and-dance form of the Ewe and Fon peoples of West Africa, an ancient dance once known as Atamga (Ga = 'great', Atam = 'oath'), now performed by the people of Dzogadze near Akatsi in the southern Volta Region of Ghana (Wikipedia). It is highly polyrhythmic in a 12/8 cycle anchored by the gankogui bell, with the atsimevu lead drum calling dancers to specific movements; it features slow and fast sections with interlude 'hatsiatsia' songs. Historically a war dance, the oath refers to one taken by ancestors before battle (Wikipedia).
card.insight: Agbekor is now a cornerstone of West African drumming curricula worldwide, transmitted internationally by Ewe master drummers and documented through ethnomusicological transcriptions of bell timelines and drum parts (Melodigging).
